title: The Beatles Ashram Rishikesh - History, Graffiti & Travel Guide
content:
The Beatles Ashram - Rishikesh,

The Beatles Ashram, officially known as Chaurasi Kutia, is one of the most unique attractions in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand. It became world-famous in 1968 when the legendary English rock band The Beatles stayed here to learn Transcendental Meditation under the guidance of Maharishi Mahesh Yogi.

During their stay, The Beatles composed many songs, some of which were later featured in their iconic albums like The White Album. Since then, the ashram has been a symbol of spirituality, music, and art.

Although the ashram was abandoned for many years, it was later restored and opened to the public as part of the Rajaji National Park. Today, it is popular for its graffiti art, meditation halls, dome-shaped huts, and peaceful trails. The blend of music history, art, and spirituality makes it one of the most fascinating places to visit in Rishikesh.

Best Time to Visit The Beatles Ashram Rishikesh:

  • Peak Season (October - March): Pleasant weather with temperatures 10°C - 25°C. Perfect for exploring the ashram, walking trails, and photography.
  • Moderate Season (April - June): Warm with temperatures 20°C - 35°C. Suitable for sightseeing but best to visit mornings or evenings.
  • Low Season (July - September): Monsoon season with temperatures 18°C - 30°C. The greenery around the ashram is lush and beautiful, but pathways may be slippery.

Things to Do at The Beatles Ashram:

  • Explore the graffiti-covered walls and art inspired by The Beatles.
  • Visit the meditation domes (Chaurasi Kutia) used for spiritual practice.
  • Walk through the nature trails inside Rajaji National Park.
  • Learn about The Beatles’ connection with India and yoga.
  • Enjoy photography in the artistic and natural surroundings.

How to Reach The Beatles Ashram:

  • By Road: Located about 3 km from Ram Jhula, accessible by auto or taxi.
  • By Train: Rishikesh railway station (5 km away).
  • By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun (21 km away).

Entry Fee: Around ₹150 for Indians, ₹600 for foreigners (subject to change).

Best Places to Visit Near The Beatles Ashram (within 50 km):

1- Parmarth Niketan Ashram (1.5 km): Known for yoga and Ganga Aarti.

2- Ram Jhula (2 km): Iconic suspension bridge across the Ganga.

3- Laxman Jhula (4 km): Hanging bridge with temples and cafes.

4- Triveni Ghat (3 km): Famous for evening Ganga Aarti.

5- Neelkanth Mahadev Temple (33 km): Mythological Shiva temple.

6- Rajaji National Park (18 km - Chilla Gate): Wildlife and jungle safaris.

7- Kunjapuri Temple (27 km): Sunrise viewpoint temple.

8- Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar (30 km): Sacred ghat for Ganga Aarti.

9- Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar (32 km): Ropeway-access Shakti Peeth.

10- Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar (34 km): Hilltop temple with panoramic views.
excerpt: Beatles Ashram Rishikesh, also called Chaurasi Kutia, is a unique blend of spirituality, history, and art. Famous for The Beatles’ 1968 stay, it now attracts travelers for its graffiti walls, meditation domes, and serene location within Rajaji National Park. A must-visit for music lovers, artists, and spiritual seekers alike.
